note: [F] Deicyde/diophantine-z-q, proved: literal_cutoff states R = D, T = (96*10^13)^13*D^(2210*G0^2*D^3) and T < 2^2^2^9013, and also the formal-multiple success for M0. The hypothesis CatalogueBound8 is proved in the repository (ZInQ.catalogueBound8), so it is not an assumption.

theorem literal_cutoff (hCAT : CatalogueBound8) :
    R = D ∧
    (T = (48 * Aht) ^ 13 ∧ T = (96 * 10 ^ 13) ^ 13 * D ^ (2210 * G0 ^ 2 * D ^ 3) ∧
      Aht = 2 * 10 ^ 13 * max (max 1 Ccm) (Q ^ 17) ∧ Aht = 2 * 10 ^ 13 * Q ^ 17 ∧
      Q = R ^ (R * E0) ∧ Q = D ^ (10 * G0 ^ 2 * D ^ 3)) ∧
    T < 2 ^ 2 ^ 2 ^ 9013 ∧
    (1 ≤ Ns ∧ 1 ≤ M0 ∧ M0 ≤ Ns ^ 10 ∧
      (Ns : ℤ) ^ 4 ∣ (normalizedRep (xi (M0 • genP0))).1 ∧
      (Ns : ℤ) ^ 4 ∣ (normalizedRep (xi (M0 • genP0))).2.1 ∧
      Nat.Coprime (normalizedRep (xi (M0 • genP0))).2.2 Ns) :=
